title.en: Mao Yancan joins vLLM-HUST as 10,000-node Ray work reaches the community
title.zh: 毛言粲加入 vLLM-HUST，Ray 万卡规模优化获社区报道

summary.en: Mao Yancan is now a vLLM-HUST organization member. Anyscale’s engineering blog credits him for contributions, benchmarks, and reviews supporting Ray Core improvements for batch inference and training clusters at up to 10,000 nodes.
summary.zh: 毛言粲现已成为 vLLM-HUST 组织成员。Anyscale 工程博客明确致谢他在 Ray Core 优化中的技术贡献、基准测试与评审，相关工作面向批量推理与最高 10,000 节点的训练集群。
